questions.question: Write one synonym and one antonym each for: 'abundant', 'brave', 'ancient'.
questions.solution:
**Abundant:** Synonym — plentiful | Antonym — scarce
**Brave:** Synonym — courageous | Antonym — cowardly
**Ancient:** Synonym — old/ancient | Antonym — modern/new
questions.knowledgeNote: Building vocabulary: Read widely, note new words, use flashcards, practice in sentences.
